<a name="Application.Emit"></a>
### func \(\*Application\) [Emit](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/application.go#L254>)

```go [application.go]
func (a *Application) Emit(event string, data any) *Application
```

Emit publishes an event on the Event Bus. Syntactic Sugar for app.Events\(\).Publish\(...\) — consistent with ctx.Emit\(\) in plugins.

Fluent style \(recommended\):

```
app.Emit("stack:layer-closed", data)
```

Alternative \(direct bus access\):

```
app.Events().Publish("stack:layer-closed", data)
```

<a name="Application.Focus"></a>
### func \(\*Application\) [Focus](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/application.go#L171>)

```go [application.go]
func (a *Application) Focus(zoneID string) *Application
```

Focus sets the focused zone at the current top stack level. Syntactic Sugar for app.Router\(\).Focus\(currentLevel, zoneID\).

```
app.Focus("main")       // focus "main" zone at current level
```

<a name="Application.Mouse"></a>
### func \(\*Application\) [Mouse](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/application.go#L155>)

```go [application.go]
func (a *Application) Mouse() *builders.MouseBuilder
```

Mouse returns a \[builders.MouseBuilder\] for registering mouse zones and handlers fluently.

```
// Register the hitbox every render cycle
app.Mouse().UpdateHitbox("sidebar", x, y, width, height)

// Register handlers
app.Mouse().Zone("sidebar").OnClick(func(x, y int) { ... })
app.Mouse().Zone("panel").OnDrop(func(from string, x, y int) { ... })
```

<a name="Application.Overlay"></a>
### func \(\*Application\) [Overlay](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/application.go#L200>)

```go [application.go]
func (a *Application) Overlay() contracts.OverlayManager
```

Overlay returns the high\-level overlay orchestration facade. It is the single entry point for all layer management: basic overlays, component overlays, and dialog primitives.

```
// Basic overlay
app.Overlay().Show("search", func() any { return searchView })
app.Overlay().Close()

// Component overlay
app.Overlay().ShowComponent(&SearchBox{})

// Dialog
app.Overlay().Dialog().Confirm("Delete?", func(yes bool) { ... })
```

<a name="Bootstrapper"></a>
## type [Bootstrapper](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/bootstrapper.go#L5-L7>)

Bootstrapper defines the interface for application boot steps. It allows the application initialization process to be modular and extensible.

```go [bootstrapper.go]
type Bootstrapper interface {
    Bootstrap(app *Application) error
}
```
